failure_states.trigger: user attempts to send an amount greater than available_balance
failure_states.recommended_message: We couldn't send £{amount} to {payee}. Your available balance is £{available}. Try a smaller amount, or move money in first.

failure_states.trigger: sort_code or account_number does not validate
failure_states.recommended_message: The sort code or account number for {payee} looks wrong. Check the details and try again.
We couldn't reach the bank. Your payment has not been sent. Check your connection and try again in a moment.

failure_states.trigger: no user activity for 9 minutes with a 10-minute session limit
failure_states.recommended_message: You'll be signed out in one minute. Anything you've typed is safe. Do you want to stay signed in?
